sla_preferences: Target uptime: 99.95% target, 99.9% guaranteed minimum; credit schedule tiered by monthly downtime

Support response times: P1 30 min acknowledgement, P2 2 hours, P3 next business day; 24x7 phone for P1
Throughput guarantee: baseline 1500 requests/sec sustained for chat endpoints with average token length 40; p95 per-request latency <500ms for short prompts when using dedicated pool
Reserved GPU planning: initial commit 8xA100-equivalent GPUs (or quantized 16xA10x equivalent), ability to burst +20% for 4 hours/day

notes:

- Quote: AE provided dedicated-reserve layout (8 GPUs) + on-prem connector demo. They want hard throughput guarantees for triage/chat traffic and clear credit schedule.
- Security: must support customer-managed KMS + audit logging and monthly retention controls; legal flagged broad SLA exclusions.
- POC: 72hr soak planned on Redwood Dedicated in NA region using their test corpus (anonymized) — objective: demonstrate p95 latency <500ms and sustained throughput 1500 rps.
- Customer said: "We can't accept opaque maintenance windows — need 14-day scheduling for planned work and immediate fallback plan."
- Internal: SE Priya to run capacity model and provide kernel-level optimizations for their model family. CSM Diego to prep onboarding runbook.
- Risks: on-prem rack power not validated; network egress policy may block KV cache pre-warm.
- Suggested concession: extend SLA credit cap for first 3 months of production to build trust; offer one-month free reserved trial for validation.
